title: A Cabin Waiting Past the Palms
style: Indie-pop, intimate young female lead vocal, conversational and lightly breathy, diary-like storytelling with crisp melodic phrasing. Mid-tempo lilting groove, chiming electric guitar, rounded bass, restrained live drums and handclap accents, soft keyboard color. Verses stay close and detailed; lift into a memorable warm chorus, then a quieter bridge and gentle final chorus. Clear modern production with warm organic texture and clean vocal-forward mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I meant to slip away last night
To the cabin by the shore
But sleep came early, pulled me under
And I never reached the door
Christmas Eve, the house was turning
Every room had something to do
Morning salt air, Gabi, Lucy
And Jairo walking with us too

[Pre-Chorus]
By lunch the late ones made it in
Then Santa came in borrowed clothes
I wrapped a ribbon, hung a star
While all the busy housework flowed

[Chorus]
Villa Jaguar, hold the day
Let the hours drift and stay
All these names around the table
All this warmth I can’t explain
Villa Jaguar, soft and bright
I’ll remember Christmas night
When the house goes still at last
There’s a cabin waiting past the palms

[Verse 2]
Turkey, goat, and dishes from afar
Midnight before we sat to eat
Then the cards were read aloud
And small hands crowded round the tree
A tablet, books, a woven tunic
Bear mittens, perfume, something blue
Lucy chose a pendant for me
And I kept thinking of you

[Pre-Chorus]
Fireworks beyond the garden wall
The villa held its quiet ground
One by one the voices faded
Poolside talk was all that sounded

[Chorus]
Villa Jaguar, hold the day
Let the hours drift and stay
All these names around the table
All this warmth I can’t explain
Villa Jaguar, soft and bright
I’ll remember Christmas night
When the house goes still at last
There’s a cabin waiting past the palms

[Bridge]
Half an hour later, there you were
The last words softened into sleep
At dawn I slipped back through the hall
Pilar saw, but let me keep
My small secret, folded close
Like the book I’ll open tonight
Cards with Alicia, beach in the afternoon
The tablet learning how to shine

[Final Chorus]
Villa Jaguar, hold the day
Let the hours drift and stay
All these names around the table
All this warmth I can’t explain
Villa Jaguar, soft and bright
Two slow days of Christmas light
When the house goes still at last
There’s a cabin waiting past the palms

[Outro]
I’ll turn a page, the sea goes quiet
And let the evening have its say
